ValidationRule.description: Restrict Sales User Edit on the Submitted/Approved Budgets
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name = "Sales", NOT(ISNEW()), RecordType.DeveloperName = "Sales", OR( AND(ISCHANGED(Status__c), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c,"Submitted")), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c),"Draft") ), AND( NOT(ISCHANGED(Status__c)), ISPICKVAL(Status__c,"Draft") ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You do not have necessary permissions to edit the Budget.
